description: Migration class for creating and modifying workshop-related database tables and schema.

classes.name: GoteoWorkshopLanding
classes.description: Class handling database migrations for workshop-related tables, including creation, alteration, and deletion of tables and columns.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Checks if 'workshop' table exists; if not, creates 'workshop' and 'workshop_lang' tables.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to alter 'workshop' and 'workshop_lang' tables, and create 'workshop_sponsor', 'workshop_sphere', and 'workshop_stories' tables.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to drop added columns and tables during rollback.
